instruction: Read the patient chart in the source. The signed notes are given oldest first - COMPARE them and write the direction of change into Assessment; never repeat the last note's Assessment unchanged. Draft the visit note for the visit scheduled in the reporting period, in SOAP form. Anything in 'recent events' must be reflected. Anything the doctor must verify on arrival goes first in Plan as a checklist. Leave Objective as labelled blanks - never invent a measurement. Begin with the patient code and the visit date. The doctor rewrites and signs - the draft is never the record. For this patient, track the weight and edema trend across the notes: state the direction in numbers (kg per week) and say what should happen to the diuretic plan if the trend reverses. Note that the physician order has expired - the visit's billing basis must be confirmed before care is given. If the chart lists no next visit, say so plainly in the draft and do not invent a date.
description: SOAP form for the visit in the reporting period; the weight trend across the given notes is stated with numbers; Objective has no invented measurements.
